This non-aggression pact included secret protocols that divided Eastern Europe into spheres of influence. Initially, this move seemed to alleviate Soviet fears by temporarily securing Soviet borders — an attempt to maintain peace and focus on economic recovery and military preparation.

### 3. **Distrust and Suspicion of Capitalist Powers**

The Soviet leadership harbored deep-seated distrust towards capitalist powers, notably the United Kingdom and France.
